original: We got separated from Yamato and\nthe others...waaaaaah!
At a time like this...if I were\nPiyomon... I could evolve and\nfly and get us back...
Because, because...if I could\nevolve, I could fly in the sky...!
I don't even know where we are\nnow...
Doesn't matter... I'll go wherever\nyou go, Takeru.
It's a village of newborn Digimon!
Why don't we try taking care of\nthem, Takeru?
Should we? Help me out, Patamon!
It's a Botamon! It's a Digimon\nbaby!
Haha! Is this a baby, too?\nIt looks like an old man with a\nbeard.
Don't say things like that! It's a\nrespectable baby.
What's this?... There's a card\ninserted here.\n"Rub me", it says.
Ah, but there's no cradle for this\none...
How dare you coddle my beloved\nbabies!
That's because... "coddling" can\nalso mean something like\n"bullying"!
We won! Wanna go at it again?\nWe'll do it as much as you want.
Gh, looks like I misjudged you. A\ndefeat's a defeat. Welcome to the\nVillage of Beginnings.
Good, good! I really don't like\nfighting.
If kids fight, they make up pretty\nquickly, but adults...
You're stronger than you look.\nEven the smallest grain of pepper\ncan still prick the tongue, eh?
By the way, do you know how we can\nget back up that mountain?
I suggest you don't, because\nDevimon's there...
I have to ask Devimon where he's\ntaken Yamato and the others.
He's not the type to just listen\nquietly. No matter what you ask\nhim, you'll have to defeat him.
I'm sure there must be another\nway.
I feel like something will\nhappen...if we join our hearts\ntogether...
To Gear Savannah, it's nearby!\nThere's a Pyocomon village\nthere...
I'm going to tell them what you\njust said! If our hearts unite, \nmaybe the island will recombine!
The split pieces will come back...
It's just a hunch...but I want to\nbelieve it!
Yeah! I'll believe in it, too!
(Someday I'm going to evolve,\ntoo. But if I do, can I spend time\nlike this with Takeru?)
Patamon? Do you want to evolve,\ntoo?
I'm fine like this! I'll stay like\nthis with you forever, Takeru!
Okay, it's a promise! We'll be\nfriends forever!
With Leomon here...what are we\nsupposed to do?
Leomon's normally a good Digimon,\nso we have to get the black gear's\npower out of him!
Can you hear me, brats? You're\nscared and hiding, aren't you?\nCome out!
If you don't come out, who knows\nwhat we'll do to this town!
(If we get the black gear out of\nLeomon, I'm sure he'll fight\nOgremon for us!)
(But if that fails, I don't know\nif I can protect Takeru...)
And the Digimon babies are all\nevacuated!
So, what are you going to do,\nOgremon?
Leomon! You're supposed to be a\ngood Digimon! Shake off those\nblack gears!
Thank you! I'm so glad you came to\nhelp, Yamato!
We're in this together, don't\nworry about it!
Thanks for helping me find Takeru,\nTaichi!
You're the one who wanted to find\nTakeru so badly, after all!
It's not working! We can't get\nthose black gears out of Leomon!
We have the power of the holy\ndevice!
The devices that came down from\nthe sky!
The devices that came down from\nthe sky!
The holy device can drive out the\ndarkness!
The holy device can drive out the\ndarkness!
You've gotta be kidding me! I\ncan't take on these guys on my\nown!
A long time ago, some rumors\nstarted circulating about our\nworld being covered in darkness...
And the "Chosen Children" from\nanother world would come to save\nit...
So you're saying that we're these\n"Chosen Children".
But you don't have any proof.
The "Chosen Children" are those\nwith the power to evolve their\nDigimon.
So you mean that if we extinguish\nthe powers of darkness, we'll\nbecome unnecessary in this world!
What do you mean by that?
In other words... we may be able\nto return to our original world.
You must defeat Devimon, who is at\nthe center of the powers of\ndarkness.
Let's do it, everyone! We won't be\nable to survive here unless we\ndefeat him.
You're right...and we have the\nholy devices, as well...
Mimi will try her hardest, too!\nIt's scary, but I wanna go home...
Yeah. We've got no choice but to\ndo it!
I will assist you, as well.
Hey, Taichi, how far are we gonna\nkeep going?!
